_about: Public-domain Joseph Bingham (1668-1723), rector of Havant, for the Word Hoard: Origines Ecclesiasticae, or The Antiquities of the Christian Church, with his other works (London: William Straker, 1834; the eight volumes found), and The French Churches' Apology for the Church of England (1706). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 74 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
